scope: Independent complete-child-binding and int-valued clear/refill workloads on Unity 6000.6.7f1 Windows x64. This does not complete #644 or #1131, establish Unity 2021.3 floor performance, or replace the unavailable original consumer harness.

environment.scheduling: Default scheduling; no affinity override. Owned builds and checks stopped during final timing captures.
environment.editorOptimization: Editor Mono default project configuration; do not compare absolute times with the Release player.

sourceIdentity.baselineReference: b1eb9326cc5d79b1333a71fa51f1a7f6eb77d758; restore only the two runtime files, keeping harness sources fixed

method.summary: Median of seven rounds per case and process, then median of three independent process medians; also report the ratio of the best process medians. Lower candidate/baseline time is better.
method.editor: 32 child warmups, 64 map warmups; each case calibrates to at least 20 ms. Full NUnit root and process health required.
method.player: 64 warmups, high-resolution timer plus a sleep control, calibration to at least 20 ms, seven rounds. Full result count, correctness assertions, zero exit, drained output, fatal-log checks and frozen binary hashes required.
method.limitations: Child timings combine array, list and set assignment, include array allocation and (player only) delegate overhead. No cold-plan timing or player allocation/retention claim. Plain editor builds in both arms emit the same ALLOC_TEMP_MAIN teardown warning; measured player logs contain no such warning. The larger NUnit IL2CPP player hit MSVC C1001, so the replayable app excludes test assemblies.
